=== internal services from admin-api container ===
gateway:7003: sh: 1: curl: not found

manager:3002: sh: 1: curl: not found

notification:3003: sh: 1: curl: not found

task:3000: sh: 1: curl: not found

event:7004: sh: 1: curl: not found

sign-tool:3004: sh: 1: curl: not found

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== internal services from admin-api container ==="; for hp in gateway:7003 manager:3002 notification:3003 task:3000 event:7004 sign-tool:3004; do printf "%s: " $hp; docker compose exec -T admin-api sh -c "curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://$hp/test/ping" 2>&1; echo; done
